# Nuon Documentation

> Nuon is a BYOC (Bring Your Own Cloud) platform that lets software vendors deploy applications directly into customer cloud accounts — no cross-account access, no shared infrastructure. Vendors package their app once using Nuon's configuration format, and Nuon handles deployment, updates, and day-2 operations in the customer's own AWS, Azure, or GCP account via an egress-only runner.

## Get Started

- [Introduction](/get-started/introduction): What Nuon is and how to navigate the docs.
- [Quickstart](/get-started/quickstart): Install the CLI, authenticate, and connect GitHub.
- [Create an AWS EKS App](/get-started/app-aws-k8s): End-to-end tutorial — package a Helm app and deploy it to AWS EKS.
- [Create an AWS Lambda App](/get-started/app-aws-lambda): End-to-end tutorial — package a Lambda function app and deploy it to AWS.

## Concepts

- [Overview](/concepts/overview): Index of all platform concepts.
- [Apps](/concepts/apps): The top-level unit — a versioned, installable BYOC product.
- [Sandboxes](/concepts/sandboxes): The base cloud infrastructure provisioned in a customer's account (EKS, ECS, AKS, etc.).
- [Components](/concepts/components): The building blocks of an app — Helm charts, Terraform modules, Kubernetes manifests, Docker builds, container images.
- [Installs](/concepts/installs): A single-tenant deployment of an app into a customer's cloud account.
- [Runners](/concepts/runners): Egress-only agents that run inside customer accounts and execute all deployment work.
- [Workflows](/concepts/workflows): The orchestrated lifecycle — provision, deploy, update, teardown — with approval gates and drift detection.
- [Actions](/concepts/actions): Vendor-defined operational scripts (health checks, migrations, diagnostics) that run inside an install.
- [Policies](/concepts/policies): OPA-based compliance rules enforced at build and deploy time.
- [Operation Roles](/concepts/operation-roles): IAM role mappings for least-privilege access during specific operations.
- [Inputs](/concepts/app-inputs): Customer-supplied values (region, instance type, API keys) that configure each install.
- [App Variables](/concepts/app-variables): Dynamic values shared across all installs of an app via the API.
- [Secrets](/concepts/app-secrets): Sensitive values like credentials and API keys used in app configuration.
- [Glossary](/concepts/glossary): Definitions of all platform terms.
